plain_english_policy: Requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before citizenship eligibility (regardless of status) is a hardline restriction on legal/illegal immigration, typically associated with stricter enforcement and reduced pathways to permanent residency.
evidence_quote: *'I support requiring all immigrants—whether they arrived legally or illegally—to return to their home country for at least one year before applying for U.S. citizenship.'*—[Candidate Name], [Campaign Document, Year]
